items.title: 68728_Jonah
items.q: And he said, 'Look here what they've got on here. Jonah Jones mute.'

ctx.x: So I used the growl, plunger, and the hummer and different things. And in the studio they was calling them mutes the Jonah Jones mutes, that bucket mute. You know, I didn't get a penny out of that, because I know they was telling me, 'Well, I hope you're getting your bread out of here, because when the arrangements come up here and CBS --' on the Sullivan Show, we was doing that show and we was also doing Garry Moore's show, and so Lawrence Brown was sitting in there on the Garry Moore Show at one time. And he…
